verdict.rationale: Column provides event webhooks, configurable via API or Dashboard, that notify your platform about events. Any rule that triggers an action has to be built in your own code on top of those notifications. Per-account-number ACH permissions and limits act as configurable guardrails, not event-triggered actions. Missing for 10: a native rules/automation engine for defining event-to-action triggers, documentation of automatic actions beyond notification, and independent hands-on corroboration.
